gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab is a dignified text serif, its c gaping wide and its lowercase tall and rounded. But Baloo Bhaina 2 is the one built to announce things, while the slab is built to keep talking.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-fauna-one: Wide-set terminals on the s give Baloo Bhaina 2 a bold, distinctive look up top. Then Fauna One, literary and dignified, settles in with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-glegoo: Baloo Bhaina 2 lands bold and distinctive, its s terminals set wide, while Glegoo below keeps big counters in a tall lowercase. One shouts the headline, the other tells the story.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-graduate: Loud and distinctive: Baloo Bhaina 2 pulls the eye with wide-set terminals on its s. Graduate does the opposite job, drawing every stem with one fixed nib and leaving generous white between letters.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-hanuman: Big personality up top: Baloo Bhaina 2 is bold and distinctive, with wide-set terminals on its s. But Hanuman, a traditional serif with a high-waisted lowercase, echoes those s terminals, and that echo is what ties them.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text speaks in a literary, dignified voice, with lowercase filling most of the letter height and big visible entrances to curves. Baloo Bhaina 2 earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-pridi: Big, brash shapes up top: Baloo Bhaina 2 spreads its s terminals wide, while Pridi keeps small letters standing proud. One is built to announce, the other to carry the text.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads bookish and dignified, with large open counters in its tall a, s and e. But Baloo Bhaina 2 brings the volume, so paragraphs below it should feel unhurried and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-baloo-bhaina-2-gf-suwannaphum: Dignified and editorial, Suwannaphum keeps a c open like a paperclip. Its high x-height gives the text a squared-off woodblock feel down the page, while Baloo Bhaina 2 handles the bold, distinctive part.
gen-gf-baloo-chettan-2-gf-epunda-slab: Baloo Chettan 2 looks magnified without changing size, wide channels into each counter. Epunda Slab then settles into a dignified rhythm, its gaping c and tall rounded lowercase keeping paragraphs open and unhurried.
